headline: Zeevonk is awarding its big packages before its own FID
hook: Zeevonk's first phase still has no final investment decision, but its cable, monopile and foundation packages are already awarded. Awards also outnumbered tenders 52 to 34 this week.
board: Of 110 new projects in 54 countries this week, 52 were awarded and 34 went to tender. Europe led with 52 projects and energy accounted for 70.
question: Would you commit crews and equipment to Zeevonk before its FID or wait for the decision?

items.headline: Boskalis wins inter-array cabling on Zeevonk phase 1, Dutch North Sea
items.what: Splash247 reports that Boskalis has won the contract to transport and install inter-array cables on the first phase of the Zeevonk offshore wind farm. Boskalis calls the award sizable, its term for €50m to €150m.
items.who: Owner: Vattenfall and Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners JV. EPC: Not named in the report.
items.angle: For marine, survey and seabed intervention suppliers: packages are being awarded before FID. Boskalis's scope includes surveys and rock installation, and engineering is set to start shortly, so subcontract and supply talks come next.
facts: Boka Ocean will carry the cables from TKF's Eemshaven plant and install them offshore.
Phase 1 is 1 GW, 63-84 km offshore. Phase 2 adds 1 GW plus 500 MW of system integration by 2032.
DEME won the transport and installation of the 69 monopile foundations in July.
items.watch: The phase 1 FID, which Vattenfall has said it is targeting for around the end of this year. Offshore installation is scheduled for 2029.

items.headline: BOMESC wins FPSO topsides contract from SBM Offshore for South America
items.statLabel: FPSO topsides contract, BOMESC from SBM Offshore
items.what: Splash247 reports that BOMESC subsidiary Tianjin BOMESC Offshore Engineering has signed with Single Buoy Moorings to design, procure and build topside modules for an FPSO bound for South America.
items.who: Owner: Not named in the report. EPC: SBM Offshore (Single Buoy Moorings). Topsides: Tianjin BOMESC Offshore Engineering.
items.angle: For suppliers of topside equipment and materials: the award covers design, procurement and construction, so purchasing for the modules follows. Fabrication will take place at BOMESC's base in Tianjin.
facts: The value is RMB1.6bn-2.1bn, with fixed and variable parts set by the actual workload.
The upper end of the value is more than BOMESC's reported 2025 revenue.
BOMESC worked on FPSO Sepetiba for Petrobras' Mero development in the Santos Basin.
items.watch: Completion is scheduled for the second half of 2028. The FPSO and the project it will serve have not yet been named.

items.headline: Gas Networks Ireland awards network services and works contract 24/006
items.statLabel: EU TED contract award, Gas Networks Ireland
items.what: An EU TED notice shows that Gas Networks Ireland has awarded contract 24/006, for network services and works on its gas pipelines, to GMC Civil & Mechanical Engineering and Murphy International.
items.who: Owner: Gas Networks Ireland. EPC: GMC Civil & Mechanical Engineering Ltd / Murphy International Limited.
items.angle: For pipe, fittings and civil subcontractors in Ireland: this is a large awarded contract for pipeline construction and network works, so supply and subcontract work will go through the two named contractors.
facts: The notice was published on 29 Sep 2026 in TED issue 188/2026.
It is classed as a large-scale award in the Pipelines & Storage subsector.
It is one of 25 Logistics & Infrastructure projects logged this week.
items.watch: The notice as captured gives no duration or lot split. TED notice 669203-2026 is the place to confirm scope and term.
